cohort: 1093 very preterm infants (gestational age <32 weeks) from 27 neonatal intensive care units.
finding: Percentile charts of TSH and FT4 levels in very preterm infants showed characteristic changes with increasing postmenstrual age, suggesting age-related cutoffs may be more appropriate than a single reference range for interpreting thyroid function in this population.
followup_time: 36 weeks postmenstrual age, 40 weeks postmenstrual age, and at discharge
